caption: The Studio screen of the app LumenCart (AI image studio) in the Shopify admin of our development store, with the heading Generate real, reviewable previews. and the label 24 credits available. A Private preview (1024 x 1024, medium-quality JPEG) shows two panels side by side: Source, Shopify product image, with the label 80% baseline, and Proposed, Generated result, with the label 99% match. Both panels show the same two snowboards (a dark one and a teal and cream patterned one) and look almost identical. Below are the buttons Image viewer, Download and Replace in Shopify (a Regenerate button is partly hidden), and on the right the source product The Out of Stock Snowboard (1 source image, 80% baseline) with the choices Keep product details (selected) and Explore a new scene. The store name in the app header and in the app card, and the store name at the bottom of the left menu, are covered.

The Billing and credits screen of LumenCart with the heading Clear economics, no surprises. and the buttons Buy credits and Choose a plan. Available balance 25 credits (0 reserved, 25 ledger balance), Credits granted 25, Credits used 0 and Current balance 25, the Current plan Free (active) and a Credit ledger with one entry, Free plan, 25 lifetime image generations, 17 Nov 2026, 21:52, plus 25. The balance still shows 25 credits and 0 used although the Studio screen showed 24 credits after one preview. The store name in the app header and the app card, and the store name at the bottom of the left menu, are covered.

The Choose the right plan window of LumenCart (Shopify subscription) with the switch Monthly or Annual (Save 15%) and five plans: Free (current), 25 lifetime image generations and 30-day verified backups; Starter $9 a month, 75 credits refreshed monthly and 30-day verified backups; Growth $29 a month, marked Popular, 300 credits and 90-day backups; Pro $79 a month, 1000 credits and 180-day backups; Scale $199 a month, 2500 credits and 365-day backups, each paid plan with a button Choose monthly. The window says that every new store receives 25 free image generations.

The Shopify page Select a plan, opened from the app after Choose monthly on the Starter plan. It says Free to test: These plans are free to test on this store. Regular pricing applies when the store goes live. Only one plan card is shown, Free, with a button Select and the lines 25 lifetime image generations, Private previews before publishing and Product search and multi-image selection. Starter and the other paid plans are not on this page, and there is no approval screen.
